A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoSyn research and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A-C. Material moved between Appendix B and Section 6.2 can be reliably matched.

before.justification: V1 reports original VLM benchmark experiments, ablations, NutritionQA evaluation, and ScreenSpot and DocPointQA pointing results, including appendix results.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experimental results, including benchmark comparisons, synthetic-data analyses, and pointing evaluations.

M1.justification: The persona-conditioned topic/data/code/instruction pipeline, 20 generation pipelines, 11 rendering tools, VLM architecture, reasoning prompts, and synthetic pointing procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same nine-category CoSyn-400K dataset, academic training datasets, seven text-rich benchmarks, NutritionQA, ScreenSpot, and DocPointQA. Moving analyses into the main text introduces no additional coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the VLM benchmarks, pointing evaluations, and GPT-4o versus Claude-3.5-sonnet generator comparison. The latter moves from v1 Table 8 to v2 Table 5. Newly cited He et al. is not added as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Training budgets, preprocessing, metrics, sample counts, and evaluation procedures remain unchanged. Figure 4's caption changes 'eight' benchmarks to 'seven', correcting the description to match the seven benchmarks already tabulated in v1 rather than changing the evaluation.

E4.justification: The diversity, rendering-tool, data-scaling, and generator-LLM analyses in v2 Section 6.2 already appear in v1 Appendix B. Training-data, chain-of-thought, question-type, and pointing analyses are also retained without additional or removed evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests, and the existing sampling descriptions are unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and findings are unchanged, including the 80.9 and 74.7 averages in Table 1, combined ScreenSpot accuracy of 74.9 in v1 Table 3/v2 Table 6, and DocPointQA results in Table 9. Relocated analyses and qualitative examples also retain their results.

T1.justification: Section 3's probabilistic formulation is unchanged. The image/text diversity definitions move from v1 Appendix B, equations (1)-(2), to v2 Section 6.2 without mathematical changes; their equation numbers are removed. No formal reasoning or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about CoSyn, CoSyn-400K, benchmark performance, efficient domain adaptation, reasoning, bias mitigation, and synthetic pointing. Relocated supporting analyses do not change these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning diversity, scaling, generator coding ability, answer biases, and generalization are retained. Limitations concerning English-only data, prompt and rendering dependence, specialized domains, and synthetic realism also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Generation prompts, rendering pipelines, queries, dataset sizes, hyperparameters, hardware, training time, generation cost, and code/data access information are unchanged. The approximately $8,000 generation cost is relocated with the scaling discussion rather than newly disclosed.

R1.justification: V2 adds He et al. (2024), 'Distill visual chart reasoning ability from LLMs to MLLMs', to the synthetic-chart discussion and bibliography. This is a limited citation addition; the broader positioning of CoSyn remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Four analysis topics move from Appendix B into Section 6.2, accompanied by localized grammar, wording, and cross-reference corrections. V2 also removes the short AI-copyediting disclosure. The overall section framework and scientific narrative remain stable.

P2.justification: V1 Tables 4, 5, and 8 and Figure 9 move into the main text as v2 Tables 3, 4, and 5 and Figure 7. Other displays are renumbered and pages reflowed. Figure 4's benchmark-count caption is corrected, while the underlying plots, tables, and qualitative images are retained.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves organization and reporting by integrating existing analyses into Section 6.2, correcting Figure 4's reference and benchmark count, and adding relevant prior-work attribution. Removing the AI-copyediting disclosure slightly reduces authoring transparency, but the net editorial gain is positive. The methods and empirical support are unchanged, so the improvement is limited.
